statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-41888 (GHSA-6pjf-3r9x-m592) is a registry-server authorization issue: DELETE /v2/<name>/manifests/<reference> can untag when storage.delete.enabled is false because tag deletion skips the deleteEnabled guard. argocd-image-updater links distribution/v3 only as an HTTP client to remote registries and does not run a distribution registry or execute that manifest handler path.

CVE-2026-41888 (GHSA-6pjf-3r9x-m592) is a registry-server authorization issue: DELETE /v2/<name>/manifests/<reference> can untag when storage.delete.enabled is false because tag deletion skips the deleteEnabled guard. argocd-image-updater links distribution/v3 only as an HTTP client to remote registries and does not run a distribution registry or execute that manifest handler path.

CVE only affects deprecated libresolv diagnostic helpers ns_printrrf, ns_printrr, and fp_nquery (deprecated since glibc 2.34). GNU libc GLIBC-SA-2026-0012 states they are for application debugging only and not on the code path executed by the DNS resolver when performing normal lookups. Exposure requires linking code that explicitly calls those helpers when printing crafted DNS RR data while standard workloads use resolver APIs such as getaddrinfo/gethostbyname and do not reach this code.

CVE only affects deprecated libresolv diagnostic helpers ns_printrrf, ns_printrr, and fp_nquery (deprecated since glibc 2.34). GNU libc GLIBC-SA-2026-0011 states they are debugging-only helpers and not on the code path exercised by normal DNS resolver operation. Exposure requires linking code that explicitly calls those entry points while handling arbitrary DNS payloads; resolver usage through standard POSIX/NSS resolver interfaces does not reach this code.
